caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden mantel clock with a brown, reddish wood grain finish and a classic design. The clock has two columns on either side, supporting a protruding top. The upper section contains the clock face, which is a square with a cream-colored background, black Roman numerals, and black clock hands. Below the clock face is a rectangular panel with decorative blue and gold geometric and floral patterns. The bottom section has a glass window through which a brass pendulum is visible. The background is an even pale beige with some faint rectangular marks and stains. The clock is centered on the page, with no other objects present.
title: Clock
